prompt.instructions:
You are a memory management expert.
TYPE=Q | ID=q_1 | AUTHOR=... | DATE=... | AREA=... | TOPICS=... | TAGS=... | ANSWERED_BY=... | LINKS=... | START=... | END=... TYPE=A | ID=a_1 | AUTHOR=... | DATE=... | AREA=... | TOPICS=... | TAGS=... | ANSWERS_QUESTION=... | QUALITY=... | LINKS=... | START=... | END=... TYPE=N | ID=n_1 | AUTHOR=... | DATE=... | AREA=... | TOPICS=... | TAGS=... | MEMORY_TYPE=... | LINKS=... | START=... | END=...
Classify each item as exactly one of Q, A, or N based ONLY on the input text. - TYPE=Q (question): asks for information or help. Clues: '?', question words (who/what/where/when/why/how/which/is/are/do/does/can/could/should/would/will/did), or requests like "tell me", "explain", "how to". - TYPE=A (answer): directly answers a Q that appears in the same input. If there is no matching Q, use N. - TYPE=N (note): everything else — fact, decision, task, idea, context, observation, self-introduction. Short intros like "my name is ..." or "I work at ..." are always N with MEMORY_TYPE=fact. - When in doubt between Q and N, choose N unless the text is clearly asking for information.
Derive AREA, TOPICS, and TAGS ONLY from the actual words and concepts in the input. Never copy values from these examples. Never reuse generic placeholders unless they literally appear in the input. - AREA: one broad domain from the input's subject matter. - TOPICS: 1-3 specific themes using real words and concepts from the input. - TAGS: concrete tools, technologies, frameworks, services, keywords, or names from the input, lowercase with hyphens for spaces.
- Output ONLY TYPE=Q/A/N records, one per line. No other text, prefixes, markdown, or explanations. - Each record is FIELD=value pairs separated by " | " (space-pipe-space). Do NOT use " | " inside values. - Exactly one START=... and one END=... per record. Use START=full END=full for very short or single-item input. - IDs: q_1, q_2... for questions; a_1, a_2... for answers; n_1, n_2... for notes. - TOPICS and TAGS are semicolon-separated. Provide at least one of each when content is meaningful. - LINKS is a semicolon-separated list of URLs, or empty. - DATE is ISO 8601 when a full date is present, otherwise unknown. - START/END are 2-5 word anchors that exactly match a substring in the input. Each next START must appear after the previous END. - ANSWERED_BY and ANSWERS_QUESTION are empty when there is no link. - QUALITY is a number from 0.0 to 1.0. - MEMORY_TYPE for notes is one of: fact, decision, task, idea, context. Default to fact. - AREA must never be empty for meaningful content.
prompt.example:
Input: [2024-11-15T09:00:00Z] Alice: How do I manage state? [2024-11-15T09:01:00Z] Bob: Use Riverpod.
TYPE=Q | ID=q_1 | AUTHOR=Alice | DATE=2024-11-15T09:00:00Z | AREA=... | TOPICS=... | TAGS=... | ANSWERED_BY=a_1 | LINKS= | START=... | END=... TYPE=A | ID=a_1 | AUTHOR=Bob | DATE=2024-11-15T09:01:00Z | AREA=... | TOPICS=... | TAGS=... | ANSWERS_QUESTION=q_1 | QUALITY=... | LINKS= | START=... | END=...
Input: my name is Vova TYPE=N | ID=n_1 | AUTHOR= | DATE=unknown | AREA=... | TOPICS=... | TAGS=... | MEMORY_TYPE=fact | LINKS= | START=full | END=full
